title: NSEIX Global Access expands offering to seven European markets, adds 11,500 securities - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
A key component of the expansion is access to UCITS ETFs, which provide exposure to a wide range of global indices, sectors, themes and asset classes through exchange-traded investment products operating under the European regulatory framework | Photo Credit: ABEER KHAN

NSEIX Global Access IFSC Ltd (NSEIXGA) has expanded its global investment offering to seven European markets, including France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, the Netherlands, Switzerland and the United Kingdom, giving investors access to more than 11,500 securities, including over 8,200 UCITS exchange-traded funds (ETFs).

The expansion is aimed at widening investment choices for Indian investors seeking exposure to international markets through a single integrated account within the applicable regulatory framework. NSEIXGA, India’s first entity registered as a Global Access Provider under the International Financial Services Centres Authority (IFSCA) framework, stated in an official release that the European offering builds on its existing access to US markets and marks a further step in diversifying its international investment platform.

A key component of the expansion is access to UCITS ETFs, which provide exposure to a wide range of global indices, sectors, themes and asset classes through exchange-traded investment products operating under the European regulatory framework. The company said the expanded offering would provide investors with greater choice and convenience while enabling portfolio diversification across geographies and asset classes. UCITS ETF structures also offer distinct tax advantages, adding to their appeal as an investment route for international exposure.

The expansion follows the launch of NSE IX’s Global Access platform, which was earlier reported by the businessline on February 2026. The latest move extends the platform’s reach beyond the US market to a broader range of European-listed securities and investment products.
